entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this useless VeloBand tracker. I've had it for a few weeks and it's just not what I wanted. I want my money back, now.
I can certainly look into that for you. So I can best assist, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?

There's no 'fault'. I just don't like it. It's uncomfortable and the battery life is a joke. I want to return it. I bought it on December 15th, you should be able to see that. I'm a VIP member, for crying out loud.

Okay, thank you for clarifying. I see your purchase date here. Sir, typically for a wearable device that has been opened and used for over three weeks, it's unfortunately too late to process a return. Our standard policy on these items is quite strict for hygiene and sanitation reasons.

What?! That's insane! Hygiene? I wore it for a bit, I didn't perform surgery with it! This is a garbage policy and I'm not accepting it. Get me your manager. I'll post about this on every social media platform you have.

I understand your frustration, and I do apologize for the inconvenience. Before I escalate the call, please allow me to just place you on a brief hold to double-check the official documentation for your specific purchase. I want to ensure I'm giving you 100% accurate information.
Fine. But you have one minute before I hang up and blast your company online.

Thank you for holding, sir. I've just reviewed your account and our knowledge base. It appears I was mistaken, and I sincerely apologize for that. Your VeloBand is actually covered under our 90-day satisfaction guarantee. You are well within the window, and I can process a full refund for you immediately.
Oh. Well... okay then. See? Why didn't you just say that from the start? So you're going to approve the return?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated it. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. You should see it in your inbox within the next five minutes. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Good. That's what I expected. About time.

And again, my apologies for the initial confusion regarding the return policy. As a valued VIP member, that's not the experience we want for you. I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account to use on any future purchase as a gesture of our apology.
Okay, a credit? That's... well, thank you. I appreciate that. Alright, I'll look for the email.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
